name: Bottom blowdown
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. A single four-second bottom blowdown every eight hours is described as more effective than one long blow; minimum blowdown line length 7.5 m; blowdown vessel design pressure at least 25% of boiler MWP (HSE PM60), vent keeps vessel below 0.35 bar g and overflow below 43 C. Evidence: https://spiraxsarco.com/learn-about-steam/the-boiler-house/bottom-blowdown?sc_lang=en-GB
